title: Leanne Morgan - The Time Of Our Lives Tour
seo_title: Leanne Morgan: The Time Of Our Lives Tour in Springfield
description: Leanne Morgan brings her stand-up comedy show, The Time of Our Lives Tour, to Great Southern Bank Arena at 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO. She is known for her Netflix special I'm Every Woman and has sold out over 100 theater and arena shows across the United States. It takes place Sunday, November 22, 2026 at 7:00 PM, with doors opening at 5:30 PM.
